properties.name: Via Egnatia
properties.text: The Roman road across Macedonia. Paul walked it from Neapolis through Philippi and Amphipolis to Thessalonica.
properties.text_zh: 横贯马其顿的罗马大道。保罗从尼亚坡里经腓立比、暗妃波里走到帖撒罗尼迦。

properties.name: Via Sebaste
properties.text: Augustus's road linking the colonies of Pisidia and Lycaonia: Antioch, Iconium and Lystra.
properties.text_zh: 奥古斯都修建的道路，连接彼西底和吕高尼的殖民城：安提阿、以哥念、路司得。

properties.name: Via Appia
properties.text: The oldest great Roman road. Paul came up it to Rome as a prisoner and was met at the Forum of Appius.
properties.text_zh: 最古老的罗马大道。保罗作为囚犯沿此路上罗马，弟兄们在亚比乌市迎接他。
